properties.name: The build's gate list is executable, not only cross-checked
properties.statement: A contributor must be able to run every gate CI runs, locally, in one command, without writing one. The list has exactly one authority — the CI workflow — and anything that runs it must READ that authority rather than keep a copy of it. Three records of the gate contract already existed and none of them executed: the workflow runs the gates, AGENTS.md lists them for a person, and skill_lint fails the build if those two disagree on coverage or on flags. So every session wanting a local pass reconstructed the list from memory, and three sessions produced three different subsets, the worst running 17 of 48 with cargo test piped through head. A local runner that reports green having run a subset is worse than no runner, because a subset and the whole set report identically. Therefore: running zero gates is a failure rather than a pass, a failing gate must fail the run in the exit code rather than only in the printed summary, and nothing may be piped through a command that closes the pipe early.
